title: The Ladies Bridgerton
author: The Ladies Bridgerton
description: Dear Gentle Reader, welcome to The Ladies Bridgerton: The Talk of the Ton. Join your hosts Tash and Patti as we delve into all things Bridgerton Universe - including the TV series, the books and all side series that Shondaland decided to grace us with. This series was previously Lady Whistledown but as it is a dual podcast now, we have changed the name to reflect that.
